### Confirmation
Author: Pastor Chuck Swindoll
Site: Insight for Living
URL: https://insight.org/resources/daily-devotional/individual/confirmation
Passage: Genesis 24:12, 14
Points:
- Abraham entrusted his servant with the critical mission of securing a godly wife for Isaac.
- Recognizing the weight of his assignment, the servant immediately saturated the endeavor in prayer.
- He asked the Lord for a specific confirmation to discern the right woman at the well.
- Believers today are guided primarily through Scripture and the Holy Spirit rather than fleece tests.
- When facing major life decisions, our responsibility is to seek God's direction and attentively listen.

### Ask God for Help
Author: Rick Warren
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/daily-hope-with-rick-warren/daily-hope-with-rick-warren-january-26-2025.html
Passage: Genesis 24:12
Points:
- Abraham's servant provides a model of turning to God for help in achieving important goals.
- Praying for success is biblical when the goal honors the Lord and blesses others.
- What we pray for reveals our level of commitment and passion for our God-given dreams.
- Failing to pray about a matter reveals self-reliance instead of dependence on God.

### A Servant's Prayer
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/servants-prayer
Passage: Genesis 24:10-14
Points:
- Abraham's servant showed fidelity and godliness by seeking the Lord's favor before acting.
- While believers must not put God to the test, asking for providential clarity between valid options is appropriate.
- The servant went to a place of labor to look for a woman displaying hospitality and diligence.
- True guidance aligns with God's revealed Word, and we must never pray contrary to biblical commands.

### A Prayer for Guidance
Author: Dr. Michael Youssef
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/leading-the-way/leading-the-way-week-of-november-2-11610595.html
Passage: Genesis 24:12-14
Points:
- Before making inquiries or resting after his journey, the servant made prayer his first priority.
- He designed his request around a test of generous, self-sacrificing hospitality.
- The prayer was powerful because the servant aligned his heart with God's covenant will.
- Confronted with daunting responsibilities, believers must trust God's providence and expect His guidance.
